title: Network-native spatial MAP5 repair
hypothesis: The five spatial MAP effects must act on nonnegative local Q72 flow before frozen forward routing, so network conservation is structural rather than a post-hoc inverse problem.
equation: local_Q*=local_Q72*exp(X_global c + sum_k z_k b_k,reach); routed_Q*=U local_Q*
spatial_parameter_model: b_k,reach=A_reach gamma_k+u_k,reach with graph-smooth Gaussian prior on every one of the 230 Reach nodes
global_features: same 17 transferable hydrologic/static features as 20260823_15 plus intercept
attribute_mean_features: ten standardized hydroclimatic Reach attributes from 20260823_16; no attribute intercept
claim_boundary: river-network conserving statistical correction of Q72 local flow; not full P-ET-storage closure and not recursive assimilation
